The '''South Power Generator Facility''' was a generator complex on the western edge of the [[Maximum Security Section]] on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Hareth]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] attempted to detonate the facility, though her actions were only a diversion so that her lover [[Executor (Sith Empire rank)|Executor]] [[Krannus]] could travel deeper into the prison.
